children: David E. Lazar disclosed a 95.7% ownership stake in Aterian, Inc.'s common stock in a Schedule 13D filed on Sep. 10, 2026. He gained the stake through a $7 million purchase of Series AA and Series AAA preferred stock and partial conversion completed after shareholder approvals on July 17, 2026. Lazar now serves as Aterian’s Chief Executive Officer and Chair, giving him significant influence over strategy and governance.

Lazar plans to "evaluate and pursue strategic opportunities for Aterian, which may include an investment in, or acquisition of, an operating business." He also holds rights to nominate directors, and two of his designees already joined the board alongside his appointment as CEO and Chair.

He may buy more shares, convert additional preferred stock, or sell holdings as he reviews the company’s progress. He states he could recommend further board changes and capital moves, and may consider mergers, asset sales, or other major transactions.

David E. Lazar is a Portugal-born investor and corporate executive who focuses on small-cap turnarounds. He often acquires controlling stakes, installs new boards, and pursues restructurings to revive struggling companies. He currently leads Aterian, Inc. as Chief Executive Officer and Chair.
